terminal_policy: Five adopted terminal roots retain ceil(max(unique allocated bytes, all regular logical bytes)/GiB)+2GiB append-only metadata margin. Stopped/incomplete observer retains its full8GiB. This grants no new bulk download, recovery, decryption, build or scientific work in any old root.

root_proof.scope: Root read complete128-line checker,93-line remote walker and report, then ran freshly under owning external guard. Metadata/receipt/seal/reservation checks only; no recovered scientific code/body requalification.

future_capacity_example.formula: terminal caps + future208GiB + independent8GiB - globally unique already-consumed allocation once; consumed bytes are not added to free space

limitations: Point-in-time six-known-root planning, not a filesystem quota, global future-budget inventory, exclusive lease or proof of global/mmap writer absence. Scoped UID1006 FD metadata found no matched-root FD, with two inaccessible observations and one race. Fresh complete contending-budget/physical checks remain required at future admission.
future_gates: Root-adopt actual green8 native/source originals; admit exact receipt/controller under passing exact-head Control; perform fresh physical/free/inode/contending-budget checks; create a separate exclusive new208GiB admission. Never reuse green7 root/reservation.
